crossRefs.note: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold…

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
translations.bsb: Then John’s disciples informed him about all these things.
translations.kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
translations.asv: And the disciples of John told him of all these things.
